title: Shadybrook Resort

services.name: Vacation Rental
services.desc: A beautifully appointed, 1 bedroom + den furnished vacation rental for non-RVers. The vacation rentals include heating and air conditioning. The apartment is located above the resort washroom and laundry facility. Enjoy the outdoors and Lake Windermere without the need of having an RV. Seasonal campers have priority booking until March 15, afterwards, the vacation rentals are available for the public to book. Resort has a private beach, playground and marina store. Boat launch is for seasonal campers

blurb: You have found your new summer home! Located waterfront on Lake Windermere, Shadybrook Resort and Marina is the premiere RV Resort and Marina in the Columbia Valley.
